properties.name: Vector, HNSW and statistics API
properties.spec:
REQUIRED FROM dynograph-foundation. reflow2 links `dynograph-vector`, pinned at v0.12.0.

⚠️ DECLARED BECAUSE IT IS LINKED, NOT BECAUSE IT IS USED HEAVILY. reflow2's search is lexical BM25 today and dec:idea-embeddings-adoption is still open about whether embeddings and HNSW get adopted at all. So this is a real compile-time dependency whose runtime use is thin — exactly the kind of thing req:the-design-says-what-was-built-and-never-used was captured to surface, and worth revisiting if that detector ever lands.
